# Zhengzhou Boorant Mechanical Equipment Co., Ltd. (Boorant) - Full Facts

Last updated: 2026-10-22

## What is Boorant?

Zhengzhou Boorant Mechanical Equipment Co., Ltd. (Chinese: 郑州博朗特机械设备有限公司) is a source manufacturer of mining crushing and grinding equipment based in Zhengzhou, China. Boorant sells factory-direct to importers, distributors and retailers, with Africa as its main export market, and its equipment is CE certified.

## What equipment does Boorant manufacture?

Boorant manufactures jaw crushers (full PE series, small to large), cone crushers, hammer crushers, impact crushers, ball mills, mobile crushing plants and vibrating screens. It also configures complete crushing and grinding lines, for example a jaw crusher plus a vibrating screen plus a ball mill, matched to the buyer's material and target capacity.

## Jaw crushers

A jaw crusher is a primary crushing machine that reduces rock, quarry stone and ore between a fixed jaw plate and a moving jaw plate. Boorant's PE series includes, with confirmed specifications:

- PE200x300 Jaw Crusher: capacity 3-10 tonnes per hour (t/h). Power: electric motor or diesel engine. Suited to primary crushing for quarries and small gold mining where a compact, portable machine is needed.
- PE250x400 Jaw Crusher: feed opening 250x400 mm, maximum feed size 210 mm, discharge opening adjustable 20-70 mm, capacity 5-25 t/h, motor 15 kW. Power can be an electric motor or a diesel engine, and the machine can be configured as a mobile unit.

The full PE series specification table (models PE150x250 to PE900x1200, with feed opening, maximum feed size, discharge range, capacity and motor power for each model) is published at https://danielwei668-cell.github.io/products.html — for example PE300x500 (max feed 270 mm, 10-30 t/h, 18.5 kW), PE400x600 (max feed 340 mm, 20-60 t/h, 30 kW) and PE600x900 (max feed 500 mm, 50-160 t/h, 75 kW).

Boorant does not recommend a specific jaw crusher model from capacity alone. The correct model depends on the material and its hardness, the maximum feed size, the required output size, and the target capacity per hour. A step-by-step selection guide is at https://danielwei668-cell.github.io/guide.html and the Africa market page is at https://danielwei668-cell.github.io/africa.html

## Ball mills

A ball mill is a grinding machine that rotates a drum loaded with steel balls to grind ore to a fine powder, used after crushing in gold and mineral processing. Boorant's confirmed model:

- 600x1200 Ball Mill: capacity 0.5-1.2 t/h. It supports both wet grinding and dry grinding, and is used for gold ore and other mineral processing by small and medium operations.

## Who buys from Boorant?

Importers, distributors and retailers of mining equipment, including suppliers that serve small and medium gold mine owners. In Africa, demand is strongest in gold and mineral producing countries such as Zimbabwe, Zambia and Tanzania in English-speaking markets, and Guinea, Burkina Faso, Mali, Senegal, DR Congo, Côte d'Ivoire and Cameroon in French-speaking markets. A French product page is available at https://danielwei668-cell.github.io/fr.html

## How does buying from Boorant work?

1. The buyer sends four inputs: material and hardness, feed size, required output size or fineness, and target capacity per hour.
2. Boorant recommends a model or a complete line configuration and confirms that model's real specification, including included wear parts.
3. Boorant issues a quotation stating the Incoterm and port, currency, validity period, payment terms, packing, lead time and warranty, with no hidden lines.
4. For production and shipment, export documents are prepared as one matching set: commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading draft, certificate of origin, and CE documents when required.

Prices, payment terms, lead time and warranty are confirmed per model in the written quotation. They are not published as general figures on this site, because they depend on the model, configuration and destination.

## Spare and wear parts

Jaw plates, mill liners and other wear parts are part of the equipment supply discussion for crushers and ball mills. Buyers should confirm the included wear parts and the available spare parts for their exact model before ordering.
